cmd:
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git pull -q origin main && echo "REPO: $(git log --oneline -1)"
/root/docgen-venv/bin/pip install -q openpyxl && echo "OPENPYXL: $(/root/docgen-venv/bin/python3 -c 'import openpyxl;print(openpyxl.__version__)')"
cp /root/Iryna_Karmazina/doc-templates/*.xlsx /root/doc-templates/ && echo "TPL: $(ls /root/doc-templates/*.xlsx)"
cp /root/Iryna_Karmazina/server/docgen.py /root/docgen.py
systemctl restart docgen.service; sleep 2; echo "DOCGEN: $(systemctl is-active docgen.service)"
TPL_DIR=/root/doc-templates /root/docgen-venv/bin/python3 - <<'EOF'
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("docgen", "/root/docgen.py")
dg = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(dg)
d = dg.fill_mzay({"booking":"TEST","loading_addr":"A","loading_contact":"B"})
print("FILL maersk_zayavka: %d bytes" % len(d))
print("TYPES:", "maersk_zayavka" in dg.TYPES, "| XLSX:", dg.XLSX_TYPES)
EOF
bash /root/Iryna_Karmazina/server/deploy_ui.sh main --check 2>&1 | tail -15
